decisions.reason: Having survived its first review, this hand-knotted wool silk carpet still fits the firm's craftsmanship and premium-material knowledge base, so management would expect to refine its market positioning rather than withdraw it soon.

This low-pile decorative carpet remains close enough to existing textile and interior know-how to be learnable, but overlap with other carpet introductions keeps the risk of later assortment pruning noticeable.

The corner bench builds directly on the firm's established furniture, customization and project-business capabilities, giving management strong ability to interpret demand and improve the offer instead of dropping it.

Although this low-pile carpet is within the firm's absorptive capacity and can be supported with existing design and materials knowledge, its similarity to other carpet launches leaves it exposed to portfolio rationalisation.

The swivel shell chair line is tightly connected to the firm's core competence in residential, workplace and public seating, and the multi-model range gives room to learn from feedback and adjust without exiting.
